title: Christ Church, Lancaster Gate - WW1 Cross
memorial_details: description: Tall column topped by a stone representation of a lantern with elaborate gilded calvary cross at its top. Whole rests on square plinth with raised wreath design on its face. The column stands on a low square stone base in a paved area surrounded by roads.  Below the gilded cross is a tabernacle with eight niches with statues. The statues are of St. George of England, St. Louis of France and the warrior saints of Christendom: Maurice, Longinus, Victor, Adrian, Florian and Eustace.
